mainEntity.name: How do SurveySparrow's response limits work?

acceptedAnswer.text: Responses are metered against your plan's cap: the free plan allows 75 responses a quarter across 3 active classic surveys, Basic allows 2,500 a year, Starter 15,000, and Business 36,000, at $19, $39, and $79 a month billed yearly. Going past the cap means buying additional responses as a paid add-on.

mainEntity.name: Can I move my SurveySparrow surveys to Formester?

acceptedAnswer.text: There is no one-click importer, but the move is quick: export each survey's responses as CSV or XLSX from SurveySparrow, then rebuild the survey in Formester by pasting the question list into the AI generator or describing it in a sentence. Most surveys rebuild in minutes, and logic rules can be re-added in plain English.

mainEntity.name: Does Formester have chat-style conversational surveys?

acceptedAnswer.text: No. Chat-thread surveys are SurveySparrow's signature format, and Formester does not imitate it. The closest Formester layout is card-style forms with one question per page and progress indicators, which serve the same goal of keeping respondents moving.

mainEntity.name: Can I use Formester for HIPAA workloads?

acceptedAnswer.text: No. Formester is GDPR, UK GDPR, and CCPA compliant, and does not hold HIPAA, SOC 2, or ISO 27001 certification. The honest read

Why do teams leave SurveySparrow?

Most of what pushes teams out traces back to one design choice: usage caps and feature gates on every tier.

Response caps shaped by the year

The $19 Basic plan allows 2,500 responses a year, roughly 208 a month. One good campaign eats the annual budget, and the free plan holds 75 responses a quarter.

Essential features live tiers up

Needing a higher plan for basics is a recurring G2 complaint. Survey translation starts at $39, custom branding and webhooks at $79, CSS and 130-language auto-translate on Enterprise.

Reporting that fights quick answers

Limited reporting options and difficult data comparisons are the two most-repeated complaints in G2 reviews, from teams that just want a readable summary of results.

Growth gets expensive fast

Three users come with the $79 Business plan. Every additional seat runs $49 per user a month, and extra responses are a paid add-on on top.

Why teams switch

Why do teams choose Formester over SurveySparrow?

Five differences that show up the first time a survey takes off.

Unlimited responses at $0

Formester never counts responses on any plan. SurveySparrow's free tier holds 75 a quarter, and every paid tier meters by the year.

25 team seats without per-user math

Business is $49 a month with 25 members included. SurveySparrow includes 3 users at $79 and charges $49 per additional user.

AI translation in 180+ languages

Included on the Business plan. SurveySparrow gates 130-language auto-translate behind Enterprise; lower tiers translate by hand.

MCP server for AI agents

Connect Claude, ChatGPT, or your own agents straight to responses on the Business plan. Nothing comparable is advertised at SurveySparrow.

AI that starts from your PDF

Generate a survey from a prompt, a pasted question list, or a PDF upload. SurveySparrow's generator works from prompts.

Migration

How do you switch from SurveySparrow to Formester?

Three steps. Your responses come with you, and the rebuild is the fast part.

1

Export your SurveySparrow responses

Open each survey's results and export the responses as CSV or XLSX. Take copies of every active survey while your plan is running; your SurveySparrow account keeps working during the move.

Time: about 5 minutes per survey.

2

Rebuild each survey with AI

Paste the question list into Formester's AI generator or describe the survey in a sentence. It drafts the questions, pages, and design in about half a minute; you adjust wording, then re-add your logic rules in plain English.

Input options: plain prompt, pasted question list, or PDF upload.

3

Repoint your links and embeds

Swap the SurveySparrow share link for Formester's, update embeds, and send one test response. Keep the old survey live for a week as a fallback, then retire it once the numbers match.

Safety net: nothing counts against a response cap while you test.

Honest comparison

When is SurveySparrow still the better choice?

Formester is not the answer for every team. Four cases where staying put is the right call.

Conversational surveys are the whole point

Chat-style surveys are SurveySparrow's identity, and reviewers consistently praise the engagement.

  • Surveys unfold like a messaging thread instead of a form
  • G2 reviewers repeatedly credit the format for better completion rates
  • Formester builds classic and card-style forms, not chat threads

Choose SurveySparrow when chat UX is the requirement

You run a full CX program

SurveySparrow is a CX platform with survey tooling, not just a builder.

  • Dedicated NPS, CSAT, and CES suite with its own dashboards
  • 360 assessments, reputation, and brand modules on the same platform
  • Formester is a form and survey builder, not a CX suite

Choose SurveySparrow to consolidate a CX program in one product

You collect responses offline or at kiosks

Offline collection is on their plans matrix; field teams keep working without a connection.

  • Offline mode and offline devices listed on their pricing matrix
  • Fits events, field research, and in-store feedback stations
  • Formester does not advertise an offline collection mode

Choose SurveySparrow for kiosk and field data collection

You need HIPAA under an enterprise contract

Their Enterprise plan carries the compliance option regulated teams ask for.

  • HIPAA compliance available on the Enterprise plan
  • Dedicated CSM and custom limits under the same contract
  • Formester is not HIPAA certified, and we say so plainly
  • Compensating controls in place: encryption in transit and at rest, annual third-party penetration testing, enforced 2FA, and encrypted backups

Choose SurveySparrow when PHI collection is part of the job

Privacy and data ownership

Your form data is yours. We don't train on it

Everything that moves through your surveys is Customer Data: the prompts you type, the structures the AI drafts, and every response someone submits. Section 4.4 of our Data Processing Addendum bars Formester from using any of it to train AI models, run advertising, or feed analytics and marketing. The Google Gemini integration that drafts surveys works inside the same boundary.

Responses travel over TLS, sit encrypted at rest, and payment data gets an extra AES-256 layer through Stripe. Formester is GDPR, UK GDPR, and CCPA compliant. We are not SOC 2, ISO 27001, or HIPAA certified, and the security page says exactly that instead of hinting otherwise.

DPA §4.4 · January 2026
"Formester shall not use Customer Data for purposes of analytics, advertising, marketing, or training of artificial intelligence or machine learning models, except as strictly necessary to provide the Services."

Formester Data Processing Addendum, effective January 2026.
